Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
com.vehiclerental.domain.Vehicle
Direct Known Subclasses:
Car, ElectricVehicle, Motorcycle, Truck, Van
public class Vehicle extends Object
Represents a vehicle that can be rented in the system.
